resources.string: Measure for 10 seconds at each place. Keep your phone in a similar position and orientation, leave the microphone uncovered, avoid speaking, and do not change the audio input or accessories.
Keep your phone still, leave the microphone uncovered, and do not change the audio input or accessories.
